onset.Description: Onset in seconds from the first sample of this file (file-relative only; the source provides no acquisition time).

trial_type.Description: Kind of interval, detected from the samples (not supplied as annotations by the source).

Levels.artifact_free_segment: Artifact-free section selected by the source authors. Consecutive segments in this file were NOT contiguous in the original recording.
Levels.zero_buffer_between_segments: Zero-amplitude buffer inserted by the source between non-consecutive segments (all channels exactly 0 uV).
Levels.zero_padding_end: Zero padding appended by the source to give every subject the same file length (all channels exactly 0 uV).
Levels.zero_samples_at_start: All-channel exactly-zero samples at the start of the file (unexpected; listed for transparency).

sleep_stage.Description: Vigilance state of the segment as given by the source. In this dataset all sections are NREM sleep (stages N2 or N3, AASM nomenclature), not separated by stage in the source files; n/a for buffers/padding.

Levels.N2/N3: Non-REM sleep, stage N2 or N3 (the source does not separate the two stages in these files)

segment_index.Description: 1-based index of the artifact-free segment within this file; n/a for buffers/padding.

n_samples.Description: Number of samples in the interval.
